author: Gert Marginet
name: CAT decorator
description: A decorator for the handlers of commands, queries or service requests, with a registration method and its test. The core project needs the package gmarginet.Cat.Decorators.Abstractions. Run it in the folder of the solution of a service.

ServiceName.description: The full name of the service, such as Contoso.Shop.Orders.

Tests.description: Add the test. Use false for a service without the project ServiceName.CoreService.Tests.

For.description: The handlers that the decorator wraps.

choices.description: The handlers of commands, with and without a result
The handlers of service requests, with and without a response
